crossRefs.note: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
crossRefs.keyword: Praise ye the Lord. Heb. Hallelujah

crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,
in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at…
Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a…
Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the…

translations.web: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
translations.bsb: Hallelujah! Praise God in His sanctuary. Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
translations.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
translations.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise God in his sanctuary: Praise him in the firmament of his power.
